contacts_email_has_source.name: contacts_email_has_source
contacts_email_has_source.value: "contacts"."email" is null or "contacts"."email_source" is not null

drafts_sent_requires_approval.name: drafts_sent_requires_approval
drafts_sent_requires_approval.value: "drafts"."status" <> 'sent' or ("drafts"."approved_at" is not null and "drafts"."sent_at" is not null)

drafts_approved_has_time.name: drafts_approved_has_time
drafts_approved_has_time.value: "drafts"."status" not in ('approved','sent') or "drafts"."approved_at" is not null

proposals_accepted_has_name.name: proposals_accepted_has_name
proposals_accepted_has_name.value: "proposals"."status" <> 'accepted' or ("proposals"."accepted_at" is not null and "proposals"."accepted_name" is not null)
